content.description: Iteration 1: keep Saval car-following values; lower red-running to the observed 9% moto share, switch on early start at the observed 13%, switch on small right-lane and sidewalk seeking from the observed per-queue choice probabilities.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car discharge headway (0.387 s) and M3/share/car (0.0027): Saval Table 11 values are kept unchanged because there is no feedback yet showing them wrong; no change, so car queue discharge and M6 approach times stay at their transferred baseline. Share 0.92 leaves 0.08 for car_seeker.

Targets M9a/M9b (straight vehicles in the right-turn lane, 0.33 veh/cycle, 2% of right-turners blocked): cars are the only custom2 candidates for right_lane use; share lowered slightly from 0.1 to 0.08 because observed right-lane use is rare. Car-following params equal car_saval so M1/car is unaffected.

Targets M1/moto discharge headway (0.30 s), M4/overshoot_share (0.625) and M5/moto_density: Saval motorcycle values kept; minGapLat stays at the lower bound 0.3 m so riders filter tightly, which supports the observed stop-line overshoot and high density. Share 0.85 leaves 0.15 for the seekers.

Targets M10a (0.27 sidewalk riders per cycle) and M9a (0.33 right-lane straight vehicles per cycle): share raised from 0.1 to 0.15 so enough riders are eligible for the small p_sidewalk and p_right_lane draws; riding params equal moto_saval so M1/moto and M6 are unchanged.

Targets M7a/release_time (2.59 s) and M7b/clear_lag (6.65 s) of the illegal-left box waiters: jmTimegapMinor kept at 1.0 s as no feedback yet shows the waiters leave too early or late; changing it blindly would confound the box metrics. Share 1.0 is required (sole archetype of its distribution).

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (0.092), M3/per_cycle (4.36) and M3/var_to_mean (1.31): base probability lowered from 0.5 to 0.1 so the moto red-running share falls toward 9%; a small swarm term k = 0.05 with cap 0.3 gives mild clustering (variance/mean slightly above 1) without runaway counts.

Targets M2/early/moto (0.130 share in the last 10 s of red) and M2/first_delay (2.1 s): p = 0.13 matches the observed early-start share directly; the 7 s window sits inside the observed 4-10 s lead time and v_max 2.5 m/s is a slow creep that moves the first crossing earlier without large overshoot.

Targets M9a (0.33 veh/cycle), M9c (queue at choice 13.3 m), M10a (0.27 veh/cycle) and M10b (queue at choice 12.7 m): trigger q = 12 m matches the observed queue at choice; p values 0.1 among seekers (15% moto, 8% car share) give rare use of about 1-3% of all vehicles, in line with the observed right_lane/sidewalk probabilities of 0.03/0.016. p_wrong_lane stays 0 because it is inapplicable on the proxy net (R27); green check off.

reasoning: No feedback yet, so changes are limited to levers with a direct mechanism from the targets: lower red-run p0 to the observed 9%, early-start p to the observed 13%, enable small right-lane/sidewalk seeking with trigger near the observed 12-13 m queue, and slightly adjust seeker shares. Car-following values from Saval left untouched.
